MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink doorbell adds visitor alerts and two-way audio to my Alexa setup, giving me a useful new function that my existing alarms do not provide.",
    "The larger Echo Show screen and the Dot with a clock connect to devices I already use, although those extra features are not compelling enough for another purchase right now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV Sticks repeat what my recently purchased 4K Max already does without offering a clear improvement.",
    "Older Echo Dots and Show 5 displays feel redundant after my newer purchases. Another basic Alexa speaker or a themed remote cover does not address an evident need.",
    "The whole-home camera bundle interests me, but I would first try a doorbell before committing to several cameras."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Alexa purchases seem to have been taken as a reason to recommend almost any Alexa device, even when I already own a newer version.",
    "My streaming-device purchase seems to suggest that I want more streaming devices, when it may already have satisfied that need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent device purchases and Show 5 stand suggest that I am already equipped for those functions; compatible additions are more useful to me than replacements with little benefit.",
    "My past alarm purchases make a doorbell with visitor communication a plausible next step, but they do not establish that I want a complete camera system.",
    "My history includes practical accessories and replacement batteries, so maintaining and extending equipment I own matters alongside buying new devices."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in Alexa, but gave too much weight to similar devices and too little to what would add a useful function to the setup I already own."
}
